notes: All 16 source and 24 target ids are partitioned exactly once.

'have committed' is kept whole on יִהְיֶה, headed on 'committed': the ASV recasts the existential clause with the man as subject, and no other morpheme in the clause could carry the lexical verb. Marking 'committed' added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause was the competing reading, named in that unit's note.
הוּמָת heads on the complement 'death' of the fixed passive 'be put to death' (rule 44), matching the treatment of מוּת elsewhere in the chapter.
